services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Camp Rokilio provides a great outdoor adventure for Cub Scouts and their parents and leaders on 213 beautiful acres of hilly terrain with tall timber located in the Kettle Moraine, seven miles east of Kiel, Wisconsin! Camp Rokilio consists of a 3-night/4-day stay in one of the camp’s 4 theme buildings: Fort J.J. Keller, Gunderson Viking Bäten Ship, Kohler Castle, and Oertle Train Station. Each building includes electricity, water, flush toilets, showers, kitchen, and living quarters with beds for both adults and youth.
